Amends sections of the Federal Power Act regarding project alterations, maintenance, and creates a new section for micro hydrokinetic project licensing.

importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Federal Power Act to exempt certain hydroelectric project alterations and routine maintenance from FERC approval requirements and establishes an expedited licensing process for micro hydrokinetic energy projects.
